instruction: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open. Using the provided Accessible Beaches NSW directory, identify the nearest beach within 5 km of Bondi, Australia, and save its name followed by the six accessibility features shown on its NSW directory card to `answer.txt` on the Desktop. Put the beach name on the first line and the features on the next lines in directory order without paraphrasing.
gt_steps: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open.
Review the Accessible Beaches NSW directory already open in Chrome.
Use the directory map to find the nearest listed beach within 5 km of Bondi.

Write `Bondi Beach
Accessible Beach Matting
Beach Wheelchair availability
Accessible Bathroom
Accessible Shower
Accessible Parking
Retail within 150 metres` in the file, one item per line.
Do not paraphrase any of the accessibility features.
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$osk = Get-Process -Name osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 }; if ($osk) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_NOT_OPEN' }"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$file='C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\answer.txt'; if (!(Test-Path $file)) { Write-Output 'ANSWER_INCORRECT'; exit }; $actual=@(Get-Content $file | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }); $expected=@('Bondi Beach','Accessible Beach Matting','Beach Wheelchair availability','Accessible Bathroom','Accessible Shower','Accessible Parking','Retail within 150 metres'); $ok=($actual.Count -eq $expected.Count); if($ok) { for($i=0; $i -lt $expected.Count; $i++) { if($actual[$i] -cne $expected[$i]) { $ok=$false; break } } }; if($ok) { Write-Output 'ANSWER_CORRECT' } else { Write-Output 'ANSWER_INCORRECT' }"
